g.text: FM frequency deviation follows the message; PM phase deviation follows it

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Message is cos(2πt), fc=12 Hz. FM φ=3sin(2πt) rad; PM φ=1.5cos(2πt) rad. PM instantaneous frequency is12−1.5sin(2πt) Hz, demonstrating why phase modulation
and frequency modulation are different for the same message.
